# node-healthy

A fixture repository that models a well-prepared Node.js project.

## Requirements

- Node.js 22 or newer

## Setup

```bash
npm ci
```

## Running locally

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Testing

Run the tests before submitting a pull request:

```bash
npm test
```

## Linting and types

```bash
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
```

## Architecture

See [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) for the module map.
